cases.sentence: Через четверть часа ___, веселый и довольный, приехал из клуба.
cases.explain: «старый граф» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: It was long since Rostóv had felt such enjoyment from music as he did that day. But no sooner had Natásha finished her barcarolle than reality again presented itself. He got up without saying a word and went downstairs to his own room. A quarter of an hour later the old count came in from his club, cheerful and contented. Nikoláy, hearing him drive up, went to meet him.

cases.sentence: И вдруг самым ___, таким, что он сам себе гадок казался, как будто он просил экипажа съездить в город, он сказал отцу.
cases.explain: «небрежным тоном» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Ah, it can’t be avoided!” thought Nikoláy, for the first and last time. And suddenly, in the most casual tone, which made him feel ashamed of himself, he said, as if merely asking his father to let him have the carriage to drive to town:

cases.sentence: — крикнул граф, вдруг апоплексически краснея шеей и затылком, как краснеют ___.
cases.explain: «старые люди» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “What! To whom? … Nonsense!” cried the count, suddenly reddening with an apoplectic flush over neck and nape as old people do.

cases.sentence: — сказал ___, разводя руками и бессильно опустился на диван.
cases.explain: «старый граф» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Well! …” said the old count, spreading out his arms and sinking helplessly on the sofa.

cases.sentence: С кем это не случалось, — сказал сын развязным, ___, тогда как в душе своей он считал себя негодяем, подлецом, который целою жизнью не мог искупить своего преступления.
cases.explain: «смелым тоном» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “It can’t be helped! It happens to everyone!” said the son, with a bold, free, and easy tone, while in his soul he regarded himself as a worthless scoundrel whose whole life could not atone for his crime. He longed to kiss his father’s hands and kneel to beg his forgiveness, but said, in a careless and even rude voice, that it happens to everyone!

cases.sentence: Ему хотелось бы целовать руки своего отца, на коленях просить его прощения, а он небрежным и даже ___ говорил, что это со всяким случается.
cases.explain: «грубым тоном» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “It can’t be helped! It happens to everyone!” said the son, with a bold, free, and easy tone, while in his soul he regarded himself as a worthless scoundrel whose whole life could not atone for his crime. He longed to kiss his father’s hands and kneel to beg his forgiveness, but said, in a careless and even rude voice, that it happens to everyone!

cases.sentence: Этой ___ Наташе, которая еще недавно играла в куклы и теперь еще брала уроки.
cases.explain: «крошечной девочке» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The countess did not believe her ears. Denísov had proposed. To whom? To this chit of a girl, Natásha, who not so long ago was playing with dolls and who was still having lessons.

cases.sentence: — Натали, — сказал он, ___ подходя к ней, — решайте мою судьбу.
cases.explain: «быстрыми шагами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He jumped up at the sound of her light step. “Natáli,” he said, moving with rapid steps toward her, “decide my fate. It is in your hands.”

cases.sentence: В это время послышался ___ платья графини.
cases.explain: «поспешный шум» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Denísov bent over her hand and she heard strange sounds she did not understand. She kissed his rough curly black head. At this instant, they heard the quick rustle of the countess’ dress. She came up to them.

cases.sentence: — сказал Денисов с опущенными глазами и ___, хотел сказать что-то еще и запнулся.
cases.explain: «виноватым видом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Countess …” said Denísov, with downcast eyes and a guilty face. He tried to say more, but faltered.
